t: You're looking at Carlyle Mansions, a block of flats on Cheyne Walk in Chelsea. It was built in 1886, and it's named after Thomas Carlyle, who lived in Chelsea for much of his life. Carlyle was a Scottish essayist, historian and philosopher, known as the sage of Chelsea. His writings strongly influenced the intellectual and artistic culture of the Victorian era, so the name ties this building to one of the neighbourhood's most celebrated residents.
